create_base_tracker_predictor: create a BaseTrackerPredictor instance with configurable stride, correlation levels, and transformer depth for video point tracking
run_forward_tracking: run the forward pass of BaseTrackerPredictor to predict 2D track coordinates across video frames given query points and feature maps
predict_visibility_scores: predict visibility scores for tracked points across frames using the built-in vis_predictor layer
build_efficient_correlation_block: build an EfficientCorrBlock or CorrBlock for computing correlation volumes between track features and video frames
update_track_features_iteratively: iteratively update track features and coordinates using EfficientUpdateFormer with flow embeddings and correlation features
